ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel dominance with a macro-level ratio of approximately 70% dark to 30% light pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and irregular geometric splotches are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe. The left lobe exhibits sparse white punctate stippling. A distinct vertical white linear feature is visible adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the lateral edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, high-contrast, three-dimensional textured clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Secondary clusters of small white circular spots are visible on the left lobe's ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization causing significant texture and pixel-intensity deviation at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters at the lobe tips create a unique, irregular silhouette that deviates from the smooth biological curve of the fluke.
